name: Keszeg (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Keszeg: a blue and red shield with antlers, a cross and a flower, supported by two yellow griffins, above a scroll inscribed KESZEG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Keszeg arms with griffin supporters and scroll
